event_source: actual EMA20/50 signals approved by ML; includes all approved timeout outcomes

training.episode_reset: round-robin, fresh capital per contiguous calendar segment
training.valuation: actual intratrade closed-bar NAV and realized exit
training.reward: trailing 30 calendar-day realized daily NAV Sharpe minus 2*max(0, drawdown-0.1)

fixed.valuation: actual intratrade closed-bar NAV and realized exit

rl.valuation: actual intratrade closed-bar NAV and realized exit

train_fixed.valuation: actual intratrade closed-bar NAV and realized exit

train_rl.valuation: actual intratrade closed-bar NAV and realized exit

cost_accounting: event net_return already includes 15bp entry and 15bp exit; no double charging
acceptance_rule: defined validation Sharpe RL > defined validation Sharpe fixed
limitations: NAV uses provided intratrade closed-bar marks when available; exit-only fallback is labeled in each metric.
All decision observations have flat position and zero unrealized PnL by nonoverlap construction.
Action sizes capital allocation only; stops and targets are fixed by the upstream real strategy.
Models and acceptance are assessed on validation; no fresh-test profitability claim.
